title: Blocs over time
hook: Watch alliances grow, split and shift from 1945 to today.
notes: Membership by year of accession. Soviet republics are shown as today's states; East Germany (Warsaw Pact) cannot be separated from today's Germany at this scale, so Germany shows West Germany's NATO membership from 1955. Albania left the Warsaw Pact formally in 1968. The UK left the EU in 2020.

scenes.title: Two camps
scenes.text: Drag the slider or press play. NATO forms in 1949, the Warsaw Pact in 1955. After 1991, many former Warsaw Pact members join NATO.

scenes.title: The European project
scenes.text: Six countries found the European Economic Community in 1958. Enlargement waves follow in 1973, the 1980s, 1995 and the big eastern expansion of 2004. In 2020 the UK leaves.

scenes.title: BRICS
scenes.text: Starting as an investment-bank acronym, BRICS became a club in 2009. South Africa joins in 2011, five more countries in 2024 and Indonesia in 2025.
